notes.title: We are the Plague - Patch #1 is now live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11464454/1cf537c56bf3a83530037f8e35ce3666ee9a350d.jpg

A new patch for We are the Plague on Steam is now live! We've listened to your feedback and the first batch of fixes and improvements is waiting for you - make sure your game is up to date!

PATCH NOTE:
- No more camping guys! Now the chance for a counter-attack when defending is lowered to 30% (previously 100%)
- Any collectors here? We added achievements for you!
- Check out the new snazzy summary screen with convenient improvements.
- Added some minor bug fixes


https://steamcommunity.com/app/992690/discussions/0/1652171126139342037/

notes.title: Game Patch | 18.08.2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/663200/ss_68c0dd96cdd9c670d174dca188089e9e7df6f278.600x338.jpg?t=1502963027

We're happy to present to you another game update! We're working on further game optimization and Rift Coaster should now run smoothly on your hardware, without stutter and glitches. Thank you for your support and suggestions that help us improve your gaming experience.

There's also a little extra for you - with this patch we added in-game music! Update your game and try it! :)

notes.title: Hotfix | 11.08.2017
notes.notes:
After reading your feedback we were able to update the game and add a quick patch to resolve the most annoying issues, so you all can enjoy the game! Thank you for your suggestions and we're looking forward for further cooperation :)

UPDATE
Improved game performance
Improved lighting
Betterment of FOG
LOD optimization
Better post-processing

WORK IN PROGRESS
further game optimization
improvement of forward renderer, so it won't glitch in game.
